preconditions.description: Contract token balance must exceed numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity threshold (100000000 * 10**10 wei)
inSwapAndLiquify must be false to allow swap execution

exploit_hint: Trigger the swapAndLiquify mechanism by transferring sufficient JizzJet tokens to the contract until balance exceeds numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity. When swapAndLiquify executes, it calls sendBNBToAdmin which uses .transfer() to send BNB to _adminWalletAddress instead of Address.sendValue() which properly validates call success. If the admin wallet is a contract with a rejecting fallback function or insufficient gas, the BNB transfer may fail but execution continues. Verify exploitation by checking if BNB remains stuck in the contract (address(this).balance > 0) after swapAndLiquify completes, indicating the transfer failed silently.
